definition.read_out: closed-form ridge regression from the feature vector to one-hot labels
definition.solution: W = (X^T X + lambda I)^-1 X^T Y; one linear solve, no gradient step
definition.cross_validation: 5 folds keyed by sha256(state_text)[0] % 5; all four goals of a state stay together
definition.targets: object (4 classes) and place (5 classes), each read separately

criteria.overall: content_present_readout_wrong if R1 or R2 is readable; representation_lacks_content if both are not_readable; otherwise inconclusive
